question: The first female sultan of Delhi sultanate, Raziyya Sultana, was the daughter of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shamsuddin Iltutmish**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shamsuddin Iltutmish:**

 
 
• Raziyya Sultana was the daughter of Shamsuddin Iltutmish (also known as Iltutmish).
 
• Iltutmish was a powerful ruler of the Delhi Sultanate and recognized Raziyya's capabilities.
 
• He nominated her as his successor, defying the traditional preference for male heirs.
 
• Raziyya ruled from 1236 to 1240 and was known for her administrative skills and military prowess.
 
• Her reign was marked by challenges from nobles who opposed a female ruler.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Muhammad Ghori:**

 
 
• Muhammad Ghori was a Ghurid ruler who laid the foundation for the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• He did not have any daughters who became sultans of Delhi.
 
• He appointed Qutbuddin Aybak as his viceroy in India.
 
• Ghori's main focus was on military conquests.
 
• He died before the formal establishment of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
 
 
• **Qutbuddin Aybak:**
 
 
• Qutbuddin Aybak was the founder of the Delhi Sultanate and the first ruler of the Mamluk dynasty.
 
• He was a slave of Muhammad Ghori and later rose to become his general.
 
• He did not have a daughter named Raziyya.
 
• He died in 1210, before Raziyya came to power.
 
• He began the construction of the Qutub Minar.
 
 
 
• **Muhammad Tughluq:**
 
 
• Muhammad Tughluq was a ruler of the Delhi Sultanate from the Tughluq dynasty.
 
• He lived much later than Raziyya Sultana.
 
• He was known for his ambitious but often disastrous policies.
 
• He did not have any connection to Raziyya.
 
• He is famous for his attempts to move the capital of the Delhi Sultanate.
